diagram_math_checks.justification: def-periodic-pic-grid-and-inner-product defines x_j=hj modulo L. Diagram nodes 0,1,2 lie at evenly spaced horizontal coordinates 0,1,2; its dimension arrow connects nodes 0 and 1 and labels their physical spacing h. These are local grid indices, not the entire five-node periodic grid.

The Statement fixes X=h/3; the particle at horizontal drawing coordinate 0.333 is the schematic one-third location between nodes 0 and 1. With d_L(X,x_0)=h/3 and d_L(X,x_1)=2h/3, the defined max{1-d_L/h,0} weights are 2/3 and 1/3, exactly the two labels. Other grid nodes have periodic distance at least h, hence zero weights.

The two dashed red connectors join the particle to nodes 0 and 1, the only nonzero-weight nodes. They are incidence guides rather than vector-valued force arrows; no force direction, extra map or commutative relation is asserted. Proof steps 1.1, 1.2 and 2.1 already calculate the weights, density and adjoint identity without using the diagram.
